summary: Implements ADR-T0586 (commit ca1b8d6) exactly: replaces the two hard-coded `liveEnabled: false` literals in src/server/agent-dispatch-loop.ts's composition root with a read of the deploy-time AGENT_LIVE_ENABLED env flag (default false, dormant/safe — ND-1 Variant A). When live, buildAgentDispatchDeps additively supplies runDeps.llmPortFactory (ND-2 Variant B) — a per-job factory that builds a fresh OpenAILlmPort from the agent's own ctx.llm config via the SAME tenantSecretResolver the assistant path already uses (src/server.ts), no duplicated SQL resolver. run-agent-step.ts's live-gate now prefers deps.llmPortFactory?.(cfg) ?? deps.llm (frozen fallback when the factory is absent, e.g. unit tests / degraded deps). A new typed classification branch routes LlmUnavailableError (configured-but-failed call: bad key/HTTP/timeout/network) to defer-to-human(signal=model, doubtReason=canonicalizeLlmError(err)) BEFORE the generic/timeout/egress fail-closed branches, so a broken key lands in the human inbox instead of parking the job. buildDegradedAgentDispatchDeps keeps its literal liveEnabled:false with an added doc-comment explaining it is an intentionally-unreachable degraded path (topics=[] short-circuits to noopHandle before runDeps is ever read).
new_gate: ci/checks/agent-live-flip-flag.sh (FF-586-1/FF-586-3, --self-test supported): function-scoped grep (awk brace-depth extraction) asserts buildAgentDispatchDeps reads AGENT_LIVE_ENABLED and contains no unconditional liveEnabled:false; asserts buildDegradedAgentDispatchDeps's OWN liveEnabled:false is doc-commented as the degraded/unreachable path (function-isolated, not conflated with buildAgentDispatchDeps); asserts no llm_connection/secret_handle SQL literal on a CODE line (comment-only mentions excluded, same comment-strip convention as anti-case-lock.sh) and that OpenAILlmPort + tenantSecretResolver are imported. Wired additively at the end of package.json's fitness chain (npm run fitness now also runs this gate + its --self-test).

open_questions: AC-8/AC-9 (LIVE_PROOF) are explicitly out of coder scope per ADR §8 ('исполнит tester ПОСЛЕ мержа + деплоя') — not attempted here. The deploy prerequisite from ADR §9 (set AGENT_LIVE_ENABLED=true in the dev stand's env and redeploy) is also not part of this PR's diff (docker-compose.yml ships the flag with a SAFE default of false; flipping the runtime env value on the actual stand is a separate deploy action, consistent with 'runtime target = container, deploy by the factory, not GT-4').

ND-2's ADR text offered two equivalent implementation shapes for the LlmUnavailableError catch handling (option (a): early return in the catch branch, vs option (b): a deferUnavailable flag threaded through the post-catch block). Implemented option (a) as the ADR explicitly recommended ('минимальнее и предпочтителен') — noted here only for traceability, not a deviation.
